panels.text: 21/08/2026 Meeting notes below - still nothing for us at this time At next call (25th August) will need to confirm timelines and SOW

Enterprise in Cloud is the current priority and will continue to receive primary resource allocation. Work on DC Exit will progress as capacity becomes available. Established solutions that need to be migrated and those that will go with the datacentre. I’ve sent an email to the Cloudteam regarding input on the location of the replacement solutions. Started decommissioning/shutting down servers that are no longer required or suspected that they’re no longer in use. Looking in to using Azure migrate to move GoAnywhere due to the amount of work required to set the solution up and migrate users, we’ll possibly need a network for Azure Migrate. Currently scoping the requirements of the backup solution and cost analysis.

17/08/2026 Production RegPlatform was migrated to Azure over the weekend of 15/16 August. The migration went well with no major issues identified during the migration. RegPlatform was taken out of maintenance mode and made available to customers on Sunday morning. Further checks were made throughout Sunday and Monday. The system is in Hyper Care and issues are being triaged and investigated and fixed where necessary, or put on the backlog.

The majority of Acin repos have been migrated, 60 are outstanding, pipeline migration is to be completed. Following review bulk migration of pipelines can take place. RAG is Amber due to status of the pipeline migration.
